verses.translation: Alleluia. I believed, wherefore I have spoken: but I was greatly afflicted.

translations.ron: Crezut-am, pentru aceea am grăit, iar eu m-am smerit foarte.
translations.grk: Ἀλληλούϊα. Ἐπιστεύσα, διὸ ἐλάλησα, ἐγὼ δὲ ἐταπεινώθην σφόδρα.

verses.translation: And I said in mine amazement, Every man is a liar.

translations.ron: Eu am zis întru uimirea mea: "Tot omul este mincinos!"
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ ἐκστάσει μου, πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης.

verses.translation: What shall I render to the Lord for all the things wherein he has rewarded me?

translations.ron: Ce voi răsplăti Domnului pentru toate câte mi-a dat mie?
translations.grk: Τί ἀνταποδώσω τῷ Κυρίῳ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἀνταπέδωκέ μοι;

verses.translation: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

translations.ron: Paharul mântuirii voi lua şi numele Domnului voi chema.
translations.grk: Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου ἐπικαλέσομαι· Τὰς εὐχάς μου τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀποδώσω, ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: I will pay my vows to the Lord, in the presence of all his people.

translations.ron: Făgăduinţele mele le voi plini Domnului, înaintea a tot poporului Său.

verses.translation: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

translations.ron: Scumpă este înaintea Domnului moartea cuvioşilor Lui.
translations.grk: Τίμιος ἐναντίον Κυρίου ὁ θάνατος τῶν ὁσίων αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: O Lord, I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast burst my bonds asunder.

translations.ron: O, Doamne, eu sunt robul Tău, eu sunt robul Tău şi fiul roabei Tale; rupt-ai legăturile mele.
translations.grk: Ὦ Κύριε ἐγὼ δοῦλος σὸς, ἐγὼ δοῦλος σὸς, καὶ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης σου, διέῤῥηξας τοὺς δεσμούς μου.

verses.translation: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of praise, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

translations.ron: Ţie-ţi voi aduce jertfă de laudă şi numele Domnului voi chema.
translations.grk: Σοὶ θύσω θυσίαν αἰνέσεως, καὶ ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου ἐπικαλέσομαι·

verses.translation: I will pay my vows unto the Lord, in the presence of all his people,

translations.ron: Făgăduinţele mele le voi plini Domnului, înaintea a tot poporului Lui,
translations.grk: Τὰς εὐχάς μου τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀποδώσω, ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ,

verses.translation: in the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, Jerusalem.

translations.ron: În curţile casei Domnului, în mijlocul tău, Ierusalime.
translations.grk: ἐν αὐλαῖς οἴκου Κυρίου, ἐν μέσῳ σου Ἱερουσαλήμ.
